steps.instruction: Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add 1 finely chopped onion and 2 cloves of minced garlic to the pot.
Sauté until the onion is soft and clear.
Add 1 diced tomato and 1 chopped hot pepper, if using.
Cook until the tomato is soft and tender.
Stir in 1 teaspoon each of ground cumin and ground cayenne pepper.
Stir in 1/2 teaspoon of ground turmeric to coat the vegetables.
Add 2 large sweet potatoes, peeled and diced, and 1 peeled, sliced carrot.
Mix well with the spiced vegetables.
Pour in 2 cups of vegetable broth or water, to mostly cover the vegetables.
Bring to a gentle simmer and cover the pot with a lid.
Cook for 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until the vegetables are tender.
steps.spoken: Cook for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring now and then, until the sweet potatoes and carrot are tender.

steps.instruction: Take the pot off the heat.
